name: Aisha Eriksen
headline: Platform Engineer
summary: Platform and reliability engineer with a strong track record of improving service stability, delivery speed and operational clarity across distributed systems. Experienced in designing dependable back-end platforms, reducing incident impact and working closely with product and engineering teams to support growth. Comfortable balancing automation, observability and system design with practical delivery.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
bullets: Stabilized the service platform by improving system design for a Scala and Spring Boot backend on GCP, cutting repeated incident patterns by 28%.
Built a reliable event flow with RabbitMQ and Git-based release coordination, reducing failed handoffs between teams by 35%.
Tightened operational checks for production changes and documented recovery steps for the on-call team, lowering mean time to restore service by 22%.
Partnered with engineers to tune deployment readiness and service boundaries, keeping critical services within uptime targets during peak load.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
bullets: Built platform automation with Ansible and Docker on GCP, accelerating environment setup from days to under 2 hours.
Standardized delivery for Kotlin, C# and Scala services running on Kubernetes and Spring Boot, improving release consistency across 14 teams.
Designed data and service workflows with Kafka and MySQL, supporting higher-throughput processing while keeping operational overhead low.
Refined cluster operations and access patterns for shared infrastructure, reducing manual intervention by 40% and improving incident response.

projects.name: Atlas Atlas
projects.description: Built Atlas Atlas around Hibernate to support structured persistence for a data-heavy internal workflow and keep model changes predictable.

projects.name: Quiet Garden
